news.title: IIRM Holdings India Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 650 million in funding
news.body: IIRM Holdings India Limited announced that it will issue 6,500 senior, unlisted, unrated, redeemable, secured, non-convertible debentures of face value of INR 100,000 for a total gross proceeds of INR 650,000,000. The transaction will include participation from new investor, Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund - Kotak Income Opportunities Fund, a fund managed by Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited, Asset Management Arm.  The deemed date of allotment of non-convertible debentures is March 31, 2026. The date of maturity of non-convertible debentures is March 31, 2030 i.e. 4 years from the deemed date of allotment. The company will pay 1% of the aggregate non-convertible debentures plus 12% interest per annum payable quarterly at end of the quarter. The transaction has been approved by the board of directors

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.69 (vs ₹0.45 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.69 (up from ₹0.45 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹609.4m (up 21% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹47.1m (up 54% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 7.7% (up from 6.1% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.1% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk High level of non-cash earnings (33% accrual ratio).
